title: Tempest Rapid Wind Gust Leaderboard
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherflow:obs
| stats max(wind_gust_kph) as max_wind_gust_kph by station
| sort - max_wind_gust_kph
description: Uses Tempest wind observations telemetry to monitor the strongest gust each station has seen in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for high-wind periods that explain damage or motion alerts, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Tempest wind observations data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It frames the strongest gust each station has seen so you can spot high-wind periods that explain damage or motion alerts before it becomes annoying.
